note: Test packages for human testers. Android only — iOS goes via TestFlight. To add a build: upload the APK to the public Supabase 'app-builds' bucket, then prepend an entry here (newest first). A build with "public": true is the one served, without a login, at /builds/android — the newest public entry wins.

builds.label: SSi Android wrapper — the app actually starts (5 Sep 21:28)
builds.commitSubject: build(android): the script points gradle at watson-1's jdk and sdk
builds.provenanceNote: THE ONE THING TO CHECK: the app should reach a real screen — the course picture, the belt, and a solid red play button you can press. The previous build (local-5e99196) spun on that button forever over a blank screen, and the reason had nothing to do with the phone: it was built on a machine with no Supabase configuration, so the installed app never made a database client and could not load a single course. It could not have worked on any handset. That build can no longer be made — the build now refuses to produce an APK without that configuration. AFTER INSTALLING, the Settings build row reads exactly: local-24b6b62, with the API host ssi-learning-app-git-dev-zenjin.vercel.app beneath it. If it still says local-5e99196 you are looking at the old install — remove it and install this one. The bottom-controls clearance from the previous build is still in here and still worth a glance under both gesture and three-button navigation. 'A newer version is available' is expected and is not a fault: the dev deployment moves on after every APK is cut.

builds.label: SSi Android wrapper — bottom controls clear the nav bar (5 Sep 13:42)
builds.commitSubject: fix(android): bottom controls clear the system navigation bar — read the real inset
builds.provenanceNote: THE ONE THING TO CHECK: the bottom control row should now sit clearly ABOVE the phone's own navigation bar, under both gesture and three-button navigation — Deborah's report on the 4 Sep build was that it sat too close to her phone controls. The clearance is read from the real inset the system reports, never a fixed height, so switching navigation mode in Android Settings should keep it right rather than break it. AFTER INSTALLING, the Settings build row reads exactly: local-5e99196, with the API host ssi-learning-app-git-dev-zenjin.vercel.app on a quiet second line, and a NEW third line reading 'insets t/r/b/l · source' — that line is the diagnostic: if its bottom number is 0 and the source says 'none', the phone is not reporting insets to the app and the conservative 64px floor is what is holding the controls clear. Cut from branch cs/582-android-bottom-controls-must-cle, which is dev plus that one fix; NOT MERGED to dev at the time of building. Web assets stay BUNDLED in the APK, so only installing this APK brings the fix to a phone — no merge and no reload can. sha256 verified against the bytes downloaded back out of the bucket.

builds.label: SSi Android wrapper — debug build (dev, 4 Sep 21:15)
builds.commitSubject: docs(android): name the rule, not the sha
builds.provenanceNote: AFTER INSTALLING, the Settings build row reads exactly: local-9b832ac, with 4 Sept 2026, 21:15 beside it on a UK-time phone (20:15 UTC — the row renders in the device's own timezone), and the API host ssi-learning-app-git-dev-zenjin.vercel.app on a quiet second line. Anything else there means an older APK is still installed. Cut from dev 9b832acc, so it carries tonight's belt-panel display grammar and fast-path position authority (bb0dffd8, absent from every earlier APK) plus the new staleness line. Web assets stay BUNDLED in the APK by design — offline-first — so 'Tap to update' cannot fetch new web code and only a new APK can; what is new is that the app now SAYS so, in one quiet line under the build row, and only when it can prove from the live deployment's build time that it is genuinely behind. On a fresh install tonight that line is silent, because this APK is the commit dev is deploying; it will start appearing once dev moves on, which is the point. sha256 verified against the bytes downloaded back out of the bucket.
